name: Attend Magic Theory
description: Core coursework. Reliable magic and knowledge gains. School mornings only.

name: Attend Combat Drills
description: Physical training with the academy's battlemages. School afternoons.

name: Study in the Library
description: Self-directed study. A knowledge check — sometimes you have a real breakthrough.

name: Practice Spells Alone
description: Risky solo practice. Big magic gain on success, but failure drains you.

name: Spend the Evening with Elara
description: Deepen your friendship with Elara. Builds charisma and your bond.

name: Advanced Arcana Seminar
description: A hidden opportunity — only open once a professor has noticed your talent.

name: Rest
description: Recover some energy and let the slot pass.
